datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule across Somalia in 2016. The spatial data represents geographic areas classified into IPC phases (1-5) indicating acute food insecurity severity, with multiple scenarios and time periods captured in GeoJSON and KML formats.
